entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"1- Reduction of amount of compensation by As claimed before the trial court.
2- Liability of insurer Insurance company be fixed to pay the compensation amount.
3- Award of interest at the rate of 6% from the date of incident. 4- Any other relief

In alternatively if this Hon'ble court has comes to conclusion that the accident was not committed by offending vehicle than Hon'ble court may permitted to withdraw the appeal and to file against the proper vehicle and in that situation the award passed by the tribunal may not come in the way of appellant and Cost of this appeal may also be awarded."

At the outset, it is submitted by counsel for appellants that because of certain mistakes in the memo of appeal, he may be permitted to withdraw this appeal with liberty to file properly constituted miscellaneous appeal.
With aforesaid liberty, this miscellaneous appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
